name: Martin Murphy

residences.place: Plymouth Township, Luzerne Co., Pa. (P.O. Kingston)

bioAdditions: In the 1870 census Martin Murphy was a miner in Plymouth Township, owning real estate worth $1,100 and personal property worth $200 (S1). With him were Alice (35) and seven children: Mary 13, Patrick 12, Catherine 9, James 7, John 4, and one-month-old twins Martin and Thomas.

conflicts.assessment: The 1870 age points to c.1820; FS's 1835 probably comes from 1880. Record both; his 1885 death/burial record would help.

sources.citation: 1870 U.S. census, Plymouth Township, Luzerne Co., Pa., p.66, enumerated 29 Jul 1870 by Roberson Boyd, P.O. Kingston, dwelling 444, family 446 (image via FamilySearch, attached to G7FL-HGY)
